en: A colorized panoramic view over a European town beside a river. The foreground shows grassy banks and trees along the water. Behind them are brick and stucco buildings with red and gray roofs. Dominating the center is a large church with two tall, slender spires. Industrial chimneys and more town buildings fill the background. The word "Grimma" is printed in red at the top left.
